name: offprompt
description: MCP server that lets Claude Code, Cursor or Codex ask you for API keys on a local page and write them to .env. The agent only ever sees key names.
long_description:
When a task needs a value only you have, such as an API key, a token or a password, the agent calls offprompt instead of asking you to paste it into the chat. offprompt opens a page in your browser, checks each value against what its registry knows of the key, and writes it into the project's `.env` or another file. The agent gets the key names and a four-emoji fingerprint, never the values. From a cloud sandbox the page is reached through a Cloudflare tunnel, and your browser seals the values to a key only the sandbox holds.

offprompt writes into the project the agent works in: the folder it starts offprompt in, or the workspace it names as an MCP root. A host that names neither gets a refusal saying so.

tools.name: collect_secret
tools.description: Gets the values a task needs, such as API keys, tokens, passwords and connection strings, written where the project reads them: the human types them on a page in their browser, which checks each against what offprompt knows of the key, or offprompt generates them. Returns the key names, the file they landed in and a fingerprint, never the values. In a cloud sandbox it returns at once with a link for the human to open.

tools.name: await_secret
tools.description: Waits up to 60 seconds for a collect_secret request that came back still awaiting, as one from a cloud sandbox does, and says whether its values are written, still awaited, or expired.

tools.name: cancel_secret
tools.description: Closes a collect_secret request that is no longer needed. Anything already typed on the page is discarded.
